items.title: Supply-chain attack compromises a popular npm package with 2M weekly downloads
items.summary: Maintainer tokens were phished; the malicious version harvested environment variables on install.

items.title: Zero-day in popular VPN appliance under limited active exploitation
items.summary: Vendor released an out-of-band patch; no public proof-of-concept yet.

items.title: Academic paper formalizes detection of ML model exfiltration via timing
items.summary: Authors propose side-channel mitigations for inference APIs that leak weights.

items.title: Europol coordinates takedown of a major credential-stealing marketplace
items.summary: Servers seized across four countries; stolen credentials shared with affected platforms.

items.title: Browser vendors ship fix for a speculative-execution leak variant
items.summary: Mitigation re-enables a previously relaxed barrier; minor perf cost on older CPUs.

items.title: Healthcare provider confirms ransomware after days of outage rumors
items.summary: Patient portals remain offline; the operator reports no evidence of data theft so far.
